notes: Stories created using canonical IDs (EVAL-CT-M1-*) to avoid duplicates.

EVAL-CT-M1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M1-S1.description: Define normalized schema for trial phase (I, II, III, IV, UNKNOWN) and associated quality score mapping to ensure consistent downstream consumption.

EVAL-CT-M1-S2.title: Implement Trial Phase Extraction and Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S2.description: Extract trial phase from ClinicalTrials.gov response, normalize values, and assign quality scores reflecting maturity (Phase IV highest, Phase I lowest, unknown handled explicitly).

EVAL-CT-M1-S3.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M1-S3.description: Integrate trial phase quality score into clinical trial results returned by evaluate_care_facade so it is available to the chat layer.

EVAL-CT-M1-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Trial Phase Quality
EVAL-CT-M1-S4.description: Validate phase extraction, normalization, and scoring across all phase values including edge cases (missing, malformed, multi-phase trials).

EVAL-CT-M1-S5.title: Integrate Trial Phase Quality into Clinical Trial Service Output
EVAL-CT-M1-S5.description: Attach computed phase quality score to each trial object returned by clinical_trials_service to ensure consistency before facade exposure.
